items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The Clef Club was meeting at Lucas' house. ... So they came by just to say hello to me

ctx.x: And George Arndorf came by to see me one Sunday afternoon, the place was just packed. The Clef Club was meeting at Lucas' house.
Yes. Not far from where I had my business. So they came by just to say hello to me, I was so busy running back and forth they said, 'Okay I see you're busy, we'll see you later.'
